workedExamples.prompt: Read “farm”. Which spelling represents the r-controlled vowel?
workedExamples.solution: The letters ar represent the taught r-controlled vowel sound.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads “start” without the r-controlled pattern. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Notice ar and reread the word as a whole.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks whether the learner can use the skill independently.
